purpose: Close the measured software supply-chain evidence gap without creating a second security truth store or changing Production runtime.

components.purpose: Dependency/source vulnerability evidence using OSV data
components.verification: official release checksum file before install
components.promotion_gate: Source scans only by default; image scanning requires an explicitly selected local image and a receipt. Findings do not automatically mutate dependencies.

components.purpose: Generate CycloneDX/SPDX SBOM evidence for Dealix source/images
components.verification: official release checksum file before install
components.promotion_gate: SBOM output is evidence only and must be attached to the exact source/image identity it describes.

components.purpose: Scan Syft/local SBOM evidence for known vulnerabilities
components.verification: official release checksum file before install
components.promotion_gate: No network target scanning; vulnerability result must preserve package/source provenance and severity/fix availability.

components.purpose: Build provenance / artifact attestation after exact-head CI becomes a trustworthy execution plane
components.promotion_gate: Do not make artifact attestation a required release gate while hosted CI is still failing before repository steps.
